feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 10 July 2026 4:02pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 10 July 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High centred to the west of sea area Shannon, drifting eastwards, with a ridge to Norway.


##Wind##

North or northwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5, but variable 2 to 4 in the east of the area at first, becoming generally north or northeast 3 or 4 occasionally 5.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but with areas of mist and isolated fog patches in the south and east of the area at times.


##Visibility##

Mainly good, but falling moderate or poor in mist and very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northeast 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the west at first, soon veering east or northeast 4 or 5, perhaps occasionally 6 in the northeast of the area


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, soon becoming mainly slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mainly good.
